description: The mast's user name. With head it keys the row, matched to the wired heads of wiring.csv and to lcos_signal_logic.csv (build_lcos_signal_manager_plan.py stops when they differ).
The head of the mast, as wiring.csv's disc_role gives it.
The switch plant the head stands at (Switch 5), copied to the plan's Plant column.
The switches the head watches, by user name, separated by |. Each must be a turnout in tables.xml with a Node:Turnout comment, or the build stops.
The head's role, copied to the plan's Signal role (main_exit).
Up to two detectors before the facing-point entrance, by user name, separated by |. Each must be a detector in tables.xml with a Node:Block comment, or the build stops.
Up to two detectors on the normal (main) path, as blocks_throat.
Up to two detectors on the diverging path, as blocks_throat.
Text copied to the plan's Boundary note.
